School of Computer Science and Information Technology
Show menu
Preparing Future Leaders in Computer Science and Digital Innovation
The School of Computer Science and IT degrees are contemporary and aligned with current industry demands, including computer science, cybersecurity, information technology, software engineering, game design, data management, artificial intelligence and more. Our students learn from industry experts, developing practical hardware skills, combining theory, hands-on projects, and industry engagement preparing them for success in their future-focused digital careers.
Study areas
Pathway programs
IT expertise can open a world of possibilities. Study one of our 100% online Associate Degrees and learn the fundamentals, allowing you to transition to a new IT profession or use it as a fast-tracked option to gain a university qualification.

Computer Science
Create the technology of the future. Computer scientists design, develop, and analyse the software and hardware used to solve a range of problems facing society. While IT specialists work with existing technology to solve a problem, computer scientists are at the forefront of building new technology from the ground-up.

Software Engineering
The software engineering sector has revolutionised our world, with software engineers introducing groundbreaking technologies that influence every aspect of society. Study Adelaide University’s Bachelor of Software Engineering (Honours) and develop the skills and knowledge to design, build and drive quality software solutions. Or, consider studying our Apprenticeship program and study software engineering while working in a full-time paid position for one of our industry partners.
Expand all

Information Management
In a world where information is vital to cultural memory, accountability, and innovation, skilled information professionals are more important than ever. Our postgraduate degrees in information management equips students with the tools to organise, preserve, and provide access to knowledge in libraries, archives, government, and beyond.

Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
With demand for AI professionals booming worldwide, this program provides you with the skills to be ready to innovate and make a real difference in fields like robotics, data science and beyond.

Engage with us
With world-leading expertise in Computer Science and Information Technology, we collaborate with industry to solve societal challenges. From issues requiring analysis and modelling, through to AI, software engineering, optimisation, and information systems to technology-enabled education, we can assist partners. We have a successful track record of partnerships with SMEs, industry giants and government.
